name: DomScan
description:
DomScan is a domain intelligence API providing domain analysis tools.

**Core Features:**
- Domain Availability: Check single or bulk domains using RDAP with 1,100+ TLDs supported
- Domain Intelligence: AI suggestions, valuations, health checks, typosquatting detection
- OSINT Tools: DNS lookup, WHOIS/RDAP, SSL certificates, subdomain discovery, IP geolocation, tech stack detection
- Social & Branding: Social handle checker, brand name scoring
- Phone Intelligence: Privacy-first phone number validation, normalization, and classification
- Pricing: Scheduled standard-TLD tables from verified official registrar sources, plus separate credential-backed exact-domain quotes
- Watchlist: Domain monitoring for expiration and availability alerts

**Authentication:**
Most API endpoints require authentication. Pass your API key via the x-api-key header or Authorization: Bearer header. Operations marked with an empty security requirement are intentionally public, including API specifications and selected catalog endpoints. Get your free API key at https://domscan.net/dashboard. Logged-in users on domscan.net tools pages are authenticated automatically via session cookie.

**Rate Limits:**
Free accounts can sustain 120 requests per minute per account, with a burst capacity of 60. All API keys and dashboard sessions belonging to the same free account share this budget.

Bulk endpoints have an additional free-tier budget of 20 HTTP requests per minute per account across all bulk endpoints. Free-tier bulk traffic is also capped at 100 requests per minute per IPv4 address or IPv6 /56 network. Platform-wide edge protections still apply to every tier.

Paid accounts can sustain 600 requests per minute, with a burst capacity of 120. API-key requests are counted per key; browser-session requests are counted per IP. Paid accounts do not receive the additional free-tier bulk budget.

Every authenticated response includes X-RateLimit-Plan, X-RateLimit-Limit, X-RateLimit-Remaining, and X-RateLimit-Policy. X-RateLimit-Limit and X-RateLimit-Remaining describe the immediate burst bucket; X-RateLimit-Policy also states the sustained per-minute rate, scope, and any free bulk limits. Exceeding a limit returns HTTP 429 with Retry-After. Retry only after the indicated delay.

**Credits System:**
API calls consume credits based on endpoint complexity. Sign up for free to receive 10,000 credits monthly.
- 1 credit: Status checks, DNS lookups, tool builders
- 2-5 credits: Health checks, valuations, OSINT tools
- Bulk endpoints: standard per-item rate for batching multiple items into fewer HTTP requests.
- 6-25 credits: Recipe compound operations

When credits reach zero, the API returns HTTP 402 with credits_remaining, credits_required, and a purchase_url. API responses include X-Credits-Requested, X-Credits-Charged, and X-Credits-Refunded. Authenticated responses also include X-Credits-Remaining. Free credits refresh monthly on the account's signup anniversary.

**Error Handling:**
Standardized API errors return JSON with type, code, message, status, retryable, request_id, and docs_url. Temporary errors can also include retry_after. Some endpoints include additional fields such as suggestion, details, login_url, or credit details. Handle HTTP 200, 201, 400, 401, 402, 403, 404, 422, 429, 500, 502, 503, and 504 in your client. Common error codes: BAD_REQUEST, UNAUTHORIZED, FORBIDDEN, INSUFFICIENT_CREDITS, RATE_LIMIT_EXCEEDED, NOT_FOUND, TIMEOUT, INTERNAL.
